query:
UPDATE lifecycle_op
            SET lease_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $2),
                attempt = attempt + 1,
                parked_at = NULL,
                parked_reason = NULL
            WHERE op_id = $1 AND completed_at IS NULL
              AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < now())
              AND (parked_at IS NULL OR $3)
            RETURNING attempt
